From whence may be concluded this first point, that they to whom God hath not spoken immediately are to receive the positive commandments of God from their Soverain, as the family and seed of Abraham did from Abraham their Father, and Lord and Civill's Soverain. And consequently in every commonwealth,

they who have no supernatural revelation to the contrary, ought to obey the laws of their own Soverain, in the external acts and profession of religion. As for the inward thought, and belief of men, which humane governors can take no notice of, for God onely knoweth the heart, they are not voluntary, nor the effect of the laws, but of the unrevealed will, and of the power of God, and consequently fall not under obligation.
